mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipment_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{orderId})
SELECT store_id FROM shipment_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{orderId}
SELECT current_status FROM shipment_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{orderId}
SELECT id,tracking_no,event_code,event_description,event_time,process_status FROM tracking_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY event_time ASC,id ASC
SELECT id,tracking_no,event_code,event_description,event_time,process_status FROM tracking_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY event_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracking_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId}

SELECT id,tracking_no,event_id,event_code,event_description,event_time,received_time,process_status FROM tracking_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY event_time ASC,id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT te.id, te.shipment_order_id AS order_id, o.order_no, te.tracking_no, te.event_time AS occurred_at, NULL AS location, te.event_code, te.event_description, 'SF_EXPRESS' AS source, te.process_status, CASE WHEN te.event_code IN ('LOST','RETURNED','EXCEPTION') OR te.process_status IN ('RETRY','REJECTED') THEN te.event_code END AS exception_code, (SELECT ec.id FROM exception_case ec WHERE ec.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND ec.shipment_order_id=o.id ORDER BY ec.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS exception_id, (SELECT a.request_id FROM audit_log a WHERE a.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND a.resource_id=o.id AND a.action_type='TRACKING_CALLBACK' ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS request_id FROM tracking_event te JOIN shipment_order o ON o.tenant_id=te.tenant_id AND o.id=te.shipment_order_id WHERE te.tenant_id=#{tenantId} UNION ALL SELECT se.id, se.order_id, se.order_no, se.waybill_no AS tracking_no, se.occurred_at, se.location, se.status_code AS event_code, se.description AS event_description, se.source, 'PROCESSED' AS process_status, CASE WHEN se.status_code IN ('LOST','RETURNED','EXCEPTION') THEN se.status_code END AS exception_code, (SELECT ec.id FROM exception_case ec WHERE ec.tenant_id=se.tenant_id AND ec.shipment_order_id=se.order_id ORDER BY ec.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS exception_id, NULL AS request_id FROM shipment_tracking_event se WHERE se.tenant_id=#{tenantId} ) events WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shipment_order scoped JOIN sys_user_store_scope scope ON scope.tenant_id=scoped.tenant_id AND scope.store_id=scoped.store_id AND scope.user_id=#{userId} AND scope.status='ACTIVE' WHERE scoped.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND scoped.id=events.order_id ) AND events.order_no = #{orderNo} AND events.tracking_no = #{trackingNo} AND events.event_code = #{statusCode} AND events.occurred_at >= #{from} AND events.occurred_at <= #{to}
mapper.select: ORDER BY occurred_at ASCDESC, id ASCDESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
